stem.text: Which statement is an example of the diffraction of light?

A.text: the addition of the amplitudes of two beams of light which are in phase

B.text: the change in direction of a beam of light when passing from air into water

C.text: the separation of a beam of white light into a spectrum of colours using a prism

D.text: the spreading of a beam of light as it passes through a small hole
